saw.short: Maya Jama steps down as Love Island host
saw.headline: *Maya Jama* is stepping down as Love Island host
saw.what: Maya Jama, 32, said on Instagram on Sunday evening that she is stepping down as Love Island host, writing “all good things must come to an end”. She mentions nine series, including the spin-offs. Love Island’s statement, reported by Metro and LADbible, thanks her for “the last three years”. No replacement is confirmed.
saw.why: A big name leaving a big show. Expect replacement guesses all week.

saw.short: Strictly's halfway-point results leave fans divided
saw.headline: Strictly’s *halfway-point results* leave fans divided
saw.what: Metro says some fans on X think the wrong couple left after Saturday’s show. Judges split 2-2 in the dance-off and Shirley Ballas’s casting vote decided it. Bethany Antonia and Nancy Xu went out, after scoring 30 against Cach Mercer and Maddie Ingoldsby’s 26 on Saturday. Dani Dyer topped the board with 36.
saw.why: A tight result with a casting vote. Strictly talk often runs all week.

saw.short: M&S Christmas ad has James Norton as a beardless Santa
saw.headline: M&S’s Christmas ad has *James Norton* as a beardless Santa
saw.what: M&S’s ad, “The Home of Christmas”, launched on Friday and runs about three minutes. James Norton’s Santa shaves off his beard, with Lucy Punch as Mrs Claus and Katherine Jenkins singing a new version of “Heaven Is a Place on Earth”. Famous Campaigns says it is the first M&S Christmas campaign to bring food, fashion, home and beauty together since 2017.
saw.why: A star-led ad people are still talking about three days on.
saw.source: Digital Spy, 6 Nov; Famous Campaigns, 6 Nov

saw.short: Queues for M&S's new cookie split social media
saw.headline: Queues for *M&S’s new cookie* split social media
saw.what: Videos on TikTok and Instagram show queues for M&S’s Milk Chocolate & Cornflake cookie, launched on 4 Nov. Some commenters called the scenes “dystopian”, others said it was “worth every second waited”. Metro says it has asked M&S for comment. Claims of fighting are second-hand.
saw.why: A food launch turned into a shared moment. Videos did the selling.

saw.short: Olivia Rodrigo's Christmas single sparks comparisons
saw.headline: Olivia Rodrigo’s *Christmas single* sparks comparisons
saw.what: Fans compared Olivia Rodrigo’s new single “take me home (4 christmas)”, released on 5 Nov, with “Christmas Wrapping” and Robbie Williams’ “Candy”. Williams then wished her a “happy Christmas” on X, which some read as shade. indy100 says neither camp has commented.
saw.why: A song, a rival and a fan theory. Christmas music is part of the season’s feed.

saw.short: Man Utd draw 4-4 with Villa; Sunderland beat Chelsea
saw.headline: *Man Utd draw 4-4* with Villa as Chelsea lose at Sunderland
saw.what: Metro reports Manchester United drew 4-4 with Aston Villa, with two goals in injury time from Joshua Zirkzee and Patrick Dorgu. It was United’s eighth league game without a win. Sunderland beat Chelsea 1-0 from an Enzo Le Fee penalty. Both results are from Metro reports.
saw.why: Big weekend football gives fans plenty to react to. Single source for now.

platform.short: Meta adds spaces to its Muse app
platform.headline: Meta adds *spaces* to its Muse app
platform.what: Meta says users can describe a custom experience in Muse and pin it to the sidebar. Its examples include a gift tracker, trivia game and wedding planner. The post says spaces are available “everywhere Muse is available”, and doesn’t say which countries that covers.
platform.why: Meta is turning an AI chat into an app builder. Not yet clear if the UK has it.
platform.source: Meta, 6 Nov; Social Media Today, 8 Nov

platform.short: A specialist says Meta shows detected discounts in ads
platform.headline: A specialist says *Meta can show discounts* it finds on your site
platform.what: A Meta advertising specialist says Meta can show discounts it detects on a shop’s website in Facebook and Instagram ads, even when promotions are off on the ad being copied. PPC Land says it is one practitioner’s observation. The setting is in Commerce Manager, under Detected offers. Meta hasn’t commented.
platform.why: Worth checking your settings if a client runs shopping ads.
platform.source: PPC Land, 6 Nov; Social Media Today, 8 Nov
